setup.google_drive: Only direct children of this folder are accessible. Supports list, metadata, text/Google Doc reads and plain-text creation up to 64 KiB. Personal My Drive uses OAuth refresh credentials; service-account creation needs a Shared Drive. Keep private operation properties for read-only recovery; no automatic repeat upload.

setup.google_sheets: Share this sheet with the service account as an editor. An operation ID is added after the data columns; keep that column intact for result checks.
setup.http_api: Configure fixed paths, methods and object input schemas with additionalProperties: false. GET uses scalar query parameters; other methods send JSON. Add a response_schema for APIs that report business errors with HTTP 200. HTTP 202 or uncertain responses stay unknown; inspection never repeats a request.
setup.slack: Reuse an existing Slack channel connection and fix a conversation ID (C, G or D). The bot needs chat:write and access to that conversation. Unknown sends are never repeated.
setup.whatsapp: Reuse a WhatsApp channel and fix the recipient's international number without +. Free-form text requires the customer-service window; approval templates are not reused. Acceptance does not confirm delivery.
setup.email: Reuse an email channel and the server's configured SMTP sender. Recipients are fixed; subject and plain text are tool arguments. Shares the workflow email recipient quota. SMTP acceptance is not delivery; partial or uncertain sends stay unknown.
setup.teams: Reuse a Teams channel's stored Workflows webhook. Acknowledgement confirms submission only; downstream delivery can still fail. Unknown sends stay blocked for manual inspection.

browserSettings.connectionHelp: No start URL belongs on the connection — URLs come from chat, workflow state, or a search tool. Discovery lists every browser tool; upload, download and evaluate stay off until you enable them below. Runs need the runtime gate.

browserSettings.proxyHelp: Applies to all browser traffic for this session. The operator must approve custom/default routes. A proxy failure never falls back to direct. Search/fetch uses its separate connection.
browserSettings.originHelp: Required: at least one exact http(s) origin per line, without paths or wildcards. Empty lists cannot be saved. Internal addresses stay blocked by network policy.
browserSettings.profileHelp: Login state is personal and restricted to declared HTTPS origins. Each run gets a fresh context; pages cannot change the selected profile.

browserSettings.resourceHelp: Expired or lost sessions stop browser actions. Approval does not extend these limits. Worker CPU/memory bounds are enforced by the operator runtime.
browserSettings.stealthHelp: Stealth mode and firewall/CAPTCHA bypass are unsupported. A proxy routes traffic; it does not guarantee access to a protected site.

browserTools.effectApproval: Click and fill always require approval on browser connections that enforce mutating effects for these tools.
browserTools.grantHelp: Grant individual browser tools on this Agent. Upload, download and evaluate also need the matching connection toggle. Runtime must be enabled on the server before a run opens a browser — see the handbook.
browserTools.executionHelp: Browser actions on the same connection in this Agent run share one ordered session. Connection limits apply. A lost, expired or uncertain session stops; node retries and cache cannot resend browser effects. Re-observe and obtain a new human decision when appropriate.
browserTools.limits: {{actions}} actions · {{timeout}} ms/action · {{idle}} s idle · {{lifetime}} s maximum lifetime
browserTools.recipeHelp: This workflow becomes a typed recipe: one Start, one End and 1–20 linear MCP browser actions on one connection. No Agent, loop, branch, node retry or cache. Choose inputs/results in Data and targets on each action. Save validates the complete sequence.
browserTools.disableRecipeBody: The workflow and its actions remain. Configure their arguments before using them as ordinary MCP nodes; recipe selectors will no longer derive references.
browserTools.recipeConnectionHelp: Changing the recipe connection updates all MCP actions in this draft. All actions must use this one connection.
browserTools.enableRecipeHelp: Enable a reusable browser recipe in Start → Settings to declare its inputs and results here.
browserTools.recipeInputHelp: Choose 1–20 required primitive state fields. The caller supplies these values per invocation; unknown arguments are rejected.
browserTools.recipeOutputHelp: Choose 1–20 object fields written by the actions. Only these results are returned, without intermediate state.
browserTools.recipeNoFields: Add suitable fields in State schema first.
browserTools.recipeToolHelp: This saved workflow is a browser recipe. Its input/result contract is fixed by the recipe; the Agent fills its typed parameters. A layout failure stops without switching to autonomous browsing.
browserTools.selectorHelp: Match one target from an earlier navigate/snapshot observation by literal role and text. Missing, ambiguous or stale targets stop the recipe. Click/fill require exact text and human review; extract may omit text only for a unique role.
browserTools.primitiveHelp: Runtime arguments use observations returned by this session. References from a different or expired page are refused. URLs may come from a state template; snapshots do not invent a start URL.
browserTools.captureHelp: Private owner-only capture, retained for up to one hour. Loading rechecks access; expired or unavailable images are not public links.
browserTools.untrustedObservation: Bounded page content is untrusted. It is shown as text, never executed.
browserTools.gatedToolHelp: This tool is listed so you can plan the Agent. Enable the matching connection toggle (and server runtime) before a run can use it.
